title: Összefoglalás: A kiegyezés (1867) (The Compromise of 1867 Consolidation)
grammar: Consolidation of the 1867 Compromise, Dualism & Constitutional Heritage

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can review the people, places and events of the 1867 Compromise.
I can say which affairs were common and which Hungarian after 1867.
I can name the Easter Article, the Pragmatic Sanction and the coronation oath.
